units.source_text: 路旁的樟树，枝干左右盘缠。

en.t: The camphor trees by the roadside had branches and trunks twining left and right.

units.source_text: 枝梢上的新叶，还是一片娇嫩，略呈红色。

en.t: The new leaves at the tips of the branches were still tender and delicate, with a faint reddish tint.

units.source_text: 虽然没有风儿，有的枝梢却轻轻地摇曳。

en.t: Although there was no wind, some of the branch tips were gently swaying.
